notes.title: Patch Notes For v0.2.1
notes.content:
Updated and improved menu UI.

Updated and improved lobby UI.

Added new abilities for agents.

Added new sounds to the game.

Fixed various bugs.

notes.title: Patch Notes For v0.1.1
notes.content:
Spatial voice range has been reduced.

 Accusing range has been reduced.

 Fixed agent ATM bug (sabotage will now trigger correctly when pressing "F" if sufficient funds are available).

 Fixed various mouse cursor issues.

 Added ability to join lobbies using a code.
